entities.summary: Gen Fukunaga  is an American engineer and entrepreneur. He established Funimation, a company that distributes anime in Canada and the United States. He was its president and chairman until he stepped down in 2019. As of October 2011, Fukunaga was chairman of online video game publisher GameSamba.
